Staylive (StayLive AB, part of Two Circles)

Stockholm, Sweden · founded 2013 · acquired · www.staylive.io · last verified 2026-09-19

Distribution layer, club and viewer splitSoftware onlyNo Italian presence foundEvidence CViewer pays

Staylive is a Swedish white-label OTT platform, owned by Two Circles since its 2024 purchase of Spring Media Group, that gives leagues, federations and youth operators such as Minnesota's Youth Sports Plus a branded streaming service with payments and apps staylive-01, staylive-02, staylive-03.

For Leagues, federations and aggregators that want their own branded streaming destination on iOS, Android and Apple TV with integrated payments under their own brand staylive-01. In youth sport it serves operators like Youth Sports Plus, which feeds Spiideo camera output into MNHockey.tv across 25,000 games a season staylive-02, staylive-04.

Staylive exists because Nordic leagues in hockey, bandy and basketball wanted to own their streaming product outright, with no rented channel, and Spring Media built it as the technology arm of a rights and production group staylive-01, staylive-05. It matters now because Two Circles bought the group in October 2024 and is pushing Staylive as a global platform provider, which puts a large agency behind a product that automated cameras feed into at youth level staylive-03, staylive-06. It tells you that distribution for automated match video is consolidating into agency-owned platforms, and that the camera vendor rarely owns the viewer relationship in these deals staylive-02, staylive-04.

Price band White-label platform fees not published; viewer prices set by the rights holder; MNHockey.tv app reviews cite roughly $9 charges without an official price list staylive-07

Italy Named customers are Nordic leagues, INDYCAR Live, Eredivisie and European swimming bodies, with no Italian rights holder found staylive-01.

Scale, company-stated

Company stated in November 2023 that it delivers in excess of 1,000 live events per week to a globally distributed audience staylive-02. Spring Media Group at acquisition distributed more than 60,000 live sporting events a year to 500+ broadcast partners staylive-03. SportBusiness reports 15 new deals signed since the Two Circles takeover staylive-08.

2025 and 2026

  • No dated 2025 or 2026 items appear on Staylive's news page as of 19 September 2026; the latest entry is the 28 October 2024 Two Circles acquisition staylive-06.

Not verified

  • Viewer subscription and pay-per-view prices on MNHockey.tv and other Staylive-powered services, since the youth pricing page requires JavaScript and the App Store lists no in-app purchases.
  • Platform fees and revenue share terms between Staylive and rights holders.
  • Whether Staylive has direct integrations with Veo, Pixellot or other automated cameras beyond the Spiideo-fed Youth Sports Plus deployment.
  • Headcount and revenue of StayLive AB after the acquisition.

Sources for this entry

Ownership and the Youth Sports Plus deal are verified from Staylive's and SportsPro's pages, but no viewer prices, platform fees or revenue shares are published, and the Staylive news feed has no entries after October 2024.
